recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key monochromatic portrait of a shirtless man from the back, holding a child on his shoulder. The image is primarily black and white with selective color applied only to gold jewelry and a subtle red graphic element in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the dark, textured skin and the bright, reflective gold jewelry
Emotional intimacy conveyed through the physical proximity of the man and child
Isolation of subjects against a deep, void-like black background
coreInvariants: Desaturated skin tones with high grain
Selective saturation on metallic gold elements
Deep black negative space surrounding the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large gold pendant resting on the man's shoulder serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the gold pendant, moves up to the child's face, then follows the man's profile to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of black negative space at the top and sides to create a somber, focused mood.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and charcoal grey (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold (chains and pendant) and deep red (top right graphic)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero saturation in the subjects, contrasted by high saturation in the metallic accents.
paletteRestrictions: No vibrant colors except for gold and dark red

letterConstructionRules: Condensed vertical bars for the numeral graphic
Blocky, high-contrast sans-serif for metadata text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Three vertical bars acting as a tally or Roman numeral III
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Functional metadata paired with an abstract geometric graphic.
graphicDevices: White rectangular container for bottom text

preserve: The vertical orientation of the top-right graphic
The high-contrast box for the bottom-left text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky, utilitarian feel of the metadata text.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the bottom label.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a man from behind holding a child on his shoulder. The man is shirtless and wearing a black cap. Add multiple thick gold cuban link chains and a large gold pendant. Use low-key lighting with heavy grain. The background must be pure black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three dark red vertical bars in the top right corner. In the bottom left, place a small white rectangle containing black condensed sans-serif text stacked in three lines.

verificationChecks: Is the skin tone strictly monochromatic?
Is the gold jewelry the only saturated element on the subjects?
Is the lighting chiaroscuro style with deep shadows?

mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the jewelry
Specific facial features of the subjects to ensure anonymity
Exact wording of the advisory label

mustAchieve: Realistic metallic texture on the gold

postGenerationChecks: Check that the gold looks like a selective color mask.
Ensure the background is deep black without noise artifacts.
Verify the grain is consistent across the man's back.
Confirm the red bars are dark and desaturated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine low-key monochrome photography with selective metallic color and minimalist geometric overlays for a gritty, intimate aesthetic.
